articles.title: Quique: "Estoy muy feliz y no pienso en el mercado"
articles.standfirst: El preparador madrileño está satisfecho con la plantilla y no quiere más movimientos en lo que queda de mercado
articles.summary: El preparador madrileño está satisfecho con la plantilla y no quiere más movimientos en lo que queda de mercado
articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores compareció ante los medios para analizar el duelo de la tercera jornada ante el Villarreal. El técnico madrileño cuenta con toda la plantilla a su disposición y espera darle continuidad a las buenas sensaciones de los dos primeros partidos. Villarreal: “Es un equipo Champions. Cuenta con un proyecto que ya lleva consolidadísimo en la élite más de 20 años, entrando en competiciones europeas y firmando jugadores excepcionales. Es un equipo que no sólo firma grandes jugadores dotados de técnica, sino que también grandes físicos. Es un equipo muy exigente”. Antonio Blanco: “Sabemos que el mercado de Blanco va más allá del Villarreal y estará abierto hasta el final. Lo que hacemos es disfrutarlo mientras está con nosotros y tratarlo como si fuera a quedarse toda la temporada". Dinámica positiva: “El fútbol te lleva a dinámicas desde que entró en una disyuntiva mental en la que los resultados son tan afectivos. Cuando las dinámicas son buenas las intentas alargar y cuando son malas hay que intentar que sean lo más cortas posibles. Estamos en una dinámica buena, pero somos conscientes de que esto no ha hecho más que empezar y sostener esto que tenemos en manos será cuestión de repetirlo mucho y de buscar nuevas herramientas”. Portería: “No creo que haya movimientos. Nos vamos a quedar con Sivera, Adrián y Swiderski, que son tres porteros de garantías. Con ellos tenemos la portería cubierta”. Virtudes del Villarreal: “Es un equipo muy físico, que juega bien, que cuanto más cerca está del área contraria es más peligroso porque tiene nivel en sus asociaciones, es capaz de desbordar, tiene altura en el balón parado. Es un equipo muy dinámico en la presión adelantada. Tiene tres o cuatro claves muy marcadas”. Iñigo Pérez: “Ha cambiado de entrenador y en cuanto al planteamiento se parece más al Rayo Vallecano de la temporada pasada que al Villarreal. Tiene más cosas de cómo a Iñigo le gusta presionar, cómo le gusta replegar y cómo le gusta atacar. Es un equipo que sabe correr al contragolpe porque tiene jugadores muy rápidos”. Continuidad del bloque: “En estas tres jornadas antes del mercado es una ventaja para los grupos que puedan haber mantenido su plantilla. Está muy bien que puedas empezar con un porcentaje del grupo que va a estar el resto de la temporada". Producción ofensiva: “No lo hemos perdido. El año pasado éramos un equipo que generaba bastantes situaciones de gol a través del centro lateral. Este año hemos empezado incluso mejor a la hora de realizar disparos. Hemos realizado 33 disparos en dos partidos y está muy bien. Es una cuestión de mentalizarse, de tener intención de llegar con jugadores cuando pisamos campo contrario”. Final del mercado: “Estoy muy feliz y no pienso en el mercado en ningún momento. Sólo pienso cuando me lo recordáis vosotros. Cuando estoy en casa, entrenando o en cualquier otro sitio no estoy pensando que se pueda romper o pueda pasar alguna cosa. Sé dónde estoy, sé que es posible que ocurra y si ocurre creo que seremos rápidos y recurrentes para amortiguar el golpe”:

articles.title: Omar Marmoush: Tottenham sign Manchester City forward on season-long loan
articles.summary: Tottenham sign Manchester City forward Omar Marmoush on loan until the end of the season, with an obligation to make the deal permanent for £60m next summer.
articles.body:
Tottenham have signed Manchester City forward Omar Marmoush on loan until the end of the season, with an obligation to make the deal permanent for £60m next summer.

The 27-year-old Egypt international will join former City team-mate Savio at Spurs, after the Brazilian moved to north London for an initial fee of £75m on Tuesday.

" Tottenham Hotspur is one of the biggest clubs in England, if not the world, and the project was very attractive to me," said Marmoush.

"I've spoken with the head coach [Roberto de Zerbi], I loved what he had to say and I'm sure our passion for the game will go very well together."

Marmoush signed for City from Eintracht Frankfurt for £59m in January 2025 and has scored 16 goals in 62 games for the club in all competitions.

After a bright start to his City career, Marmoush made 13 of his 21 league appearances last term from the bench with Norway international Erling Haaland the club's preferred central striker.

Marmoush was utilised as a second-half substitute in City's 3-0 Community Shield defeat by Arsenal and was an unused substitute in their 2-1 Premier League win over Bournemouth last Sunday.

Spurs have spent more than £312m in the transfer window this summer.

They have signed Mateus Fernandes from West Ham, Sandro Tonali from Newcastle and Jan Paul van Hecke from Brighton , while defenders Marcos Senesi and Andy Robertson, plus goalkeeper Martin Dubravka, have arrived on free transfers.

Speaking about their most recent arrival, De Zerbi said: "Omar is exactly the kind of player we want at this club - ambitious, hungry and determined to make a difference.

"He has incredible attacking quality but what I also love is his desire to improve and to win.

"He brings pace, intelligence and a real threat in front of goal, and I believe he can take our attacking play to another level."

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: Uefa pursuing criminal legal proceedings against Fifa president
articles.summary: Uefa is pursuing criminal proceedings against Fifa president Gianni Infantino over the scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup.
articles.body:
Uefa is preparing criminal legal proceedings against Fifa president Gianni Infantino over the now scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup and its other competitions to private investors.

Documents seen by BBC Sport show an application has been made by European football's governing body requesting access to evidence and documents for use in proceedings in Switzerland against the embattled president himself, who Uefa accuses of "criminal mismanagement".

Uefa also says it is considering pursuing criminal action against other Fifa officials.

Shortly after this summer's World Cup, Infantino proposed creating a new company, Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE), which would have sold off stakes in Fifa's football competitions to private investors.

In the application for evidence, Uefa said: "In truth, it was a vehicle for Infantino and that small circle to acquire a permanent stake in and otherwise profit from Fifa's most valuable assets to the detriment of Fifa, its members, and other parties within the football family," Uefa's application says.

"Infantino pushed the plan through internal Fifa approval only days earlier at a hastily convened meeting where a limited number of Fifa's management officials and employees - some of whom had never heard of the plan - were given mere hours to sign off on an unprecedented multi-billion dollar scheme."

Key figures at Uefa and in European football met today in Monaco before the Champions League draw, where Infantino's status was one item on the agenda.

A statement sent to the media by Uefa said: "Those present unanimously mandated the Uefa president and administration to pursue every available institutional, political and legal avenue necessary to secure fundamental reform, restore proper limits on presidential authority and ensure that Fifa is once again governed as an institution – not around one individual."

BBC Sport has approached Infantino and Fifa for comment.

What does Uefa say in its legal application?

Uefa claims that the valuation of the stakes to be sold were not independently verified and would have been offered too cheaply, calling the proposed sale "a fraudulently off-market price promoted by Infantino for his own benefit".

The application adds: "Under the terms Infantino announced, those investors stood to acquire a permanent financial interest in Fifa's commercial arm for $4.2bn, implying an absurdly low enterprise value of only approximately $20bn, a figure that was neither the product of an open, competitive auction, nor tested by any independent valuer."

In the application, Uefa is applying to a court in Florida to attempt to access files held by two Fifa businesses - Fifa Americas and FWC2026 - to be used to pursue the criminal charges in Switzerland at a later stage.

The two businesses are based in Florida.

Uefa claims that its 55 member nations would have potentially been harmed by the sell-off plan, and that it may pursue criminal proceedings against other Fifa officials as well as Infantino.

"Uefa and other interested parties are preparing to bring criminal claims in Switzerland against Infantino and possibly other Fifa officials and advisors for criminal mismanagement," the application states.

"The secretive structuring, valuation, financing, and marketing inflicted direct and concrete injury on Fifa's reputation, governance authority, and commercial relationships to the detriment of Fifa as well as its 211 members, including Uefa's 55 member associations."

Uefa insists that the plan was concocted without the knowledge of them or other key stakeholders in football, and that it had been long in development.

The applications says: "On July 28, 2026, without consulting the Fifa Council, Uefa, or any of the other confederations, or any of the 211 Fifa member associations, Infantino, purportedly acting on behalf of Fifa, publicly announced a plan to place the commercial rights to the men's and women's World Cups and the Club World Cup into a new subsidiary: Fifa Forward Enterprise.

"That announcement by Infantino was the public unveiling of a plan that he and a small circle of co-conspirators had conceived and reportedly been developing in secret for more than a year."

Uefa states in the document that there has been "an enduring history of corruption among Fifa officials" and claims that world football's governing body only relents on its plans when pressure comes from outside the sport.

"Fifa's extraordinary power over world football has operated largely without meaningful internal constraint, with accountability coming principally through external forces, including political pressure, public scrutiny, and intervention through international criminal law enforcement," the application adds.

Fifa's headquarters are in the Swiss city of Zurich, and Uefa says that its plan to eventually pursue criminal charges against Infantino is backed up by Swiss law.

"Swiss counsel has confirmed [...] that the proceeding is within reasonable contemplation for purposes of Swiss law and that Uefa has standing, as a complainant, to file a criminal complaint for criminal mismanagement against Infantino and potentially other Fifa officials as may be warranted."

BBC Sport has been told that a separate filing has been lodged to a court in New York, where Uefa is seeking documentation from Thrive Capital, the business proposed to take up an interest in FFE, and its founder Josh Kushner, the brother of US president Donald Trump's son-in-law.

The American investment bank JP Morgan is also named in the application.

A third application has also been made in Colorado, relating to former Formula 1 chief Greg Maffei, who is referred to in the court filings as "the key commercial adviser" on the proposed FFE transaction, and his Bann Ventures firm.

BBC Sport has also approached Uefa for comment.

Why has Infantino's plan been so controversial?

Infantino offered Fifa's 211 member associations $40m (£30m) if they backed the proposal for private investment in its tournaments via FFE, including the men's and women's World Cups.

The Swiss has faced calls to step down after he scrapped the controversial plan earlier this month.

Uefa has led the backlash to the proposal, stating it had lost confidence in Infantino, and with its members voting to boycott World Cups unless the FFE plan was scrapped.

Infantino, who is seeking a fourth a term as Fifa president in March, was accused of breaking trust "through deception" in an open letter issued by Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation.

The football associations of all the home nations have withdrawn support for Infantino, but he retains the support of South American governing body Conmebol and Caf, the African governing body, while some nations have broken ranks from their confederations to come out in support of the Fifa president.

'Pressure on Infantino has ramped up again' - analysis

This is another escalation in world football's increasingly acrimonious civil war.

Infantino may have felt emboldened by Uefa dropping their threat of a boycott of Fifa competitions, and the qualified backing of the highly influential Saudi Arabia.

But the news that Uefa is considering bringing criminal proceedings against him ensures the pressure has ramped up yet again.

Put simply, Uefa is not letting up, and it will be hoping the prospect of subpoenas and enforced disclosure of documents - along with a reference to a possible custodial sentence if found guilty of criminal mismanagement under Swiss law - is enough to oust him, rather than fight on and seek re-election in March.

However, legal disputes in sport have a tendency to drag on and it is unclear how long this may take, and whether Uefa gets the backing from the courts it is seeking.

articles.title: Omar Marmoush transfer news: Tottenham sign Man City forward on loan with £60m obligation to buy
articles.summary: Tottenham have signed Omar Marmoush on loan from Manchester City; Spurs have a £60m obligation to buy the forward, which is split into £50m initial fee and £10m in add-ons; Marmoush follows former City team-mate Savio to Spurs, who signed on Tuesday
articles.body:
Sky Sports News understands a £60m obligation to buy has been inserted in the deal and the fee is split into a £50m guaranteed payment, plus £10m in add-ons.

Eintracht Frankfurt, who sold Marmoush to City in January 2025, do not have a sell-on clause, contrary to reports.

The German club received their desired guaranteed fee at the time, plus additional bonuses.

There were also very few instalments, meaning all payment obligations to Frankfurt have been fulfilled by City.

Marmoush, who will wear the No 22 at Spurs, now follows former City teammate Savio to join Roberto De Zerbi's squad, after the Brazil winger completed an £85m move to Spurs on Tuesday .

Savio made his debut for the club during Wednesday's 5-1 win against Charlton in the Carabao Cup, where he scored and assisted Ben Davies in the victory.

De Zerbi: Marmoush can take our attack to next level

De Zerbi believes the addition of Marmoush to his squad can take their attacking play to the "next level" with the pace, intelligence and threat he offers in front of goal.

"Omar is exactly the kind of player we want at this club - ambitious, hungry and determined to make a difference," De Zerbi said.

"He has incredible attacking quality but what I also love is his desire to improve and to win.

"He brings pace, intelligence and a real threat in front of goal, and I believe he can take our attacking play to another level."

Speaking after his signing was confirmed, Marmoush said: "It feels amazing to be here. I'm so excited to get started with the team and I can't wait to meet the fans.

"Tottenham Hotspur is one of the biggest clubs in England, if not the world, and the project was very attractive to me.

"I've spoken with the head coach, I loved what he had to say and I'm sure our passion for the game will go very well together."

articles.title: Jenson Seelt: Swansea City sign Sunderland defender on loan for rest of season
articles.summary: Swansea City sign Sunderland defender Jenson Seelt on loan for the remainder of the season.
articles.body:
Swansea City have signed Sunderland defender Jenson Seelt on loan for the remainder of the season.

The Dutch centre-back, 23, has played 21 times for Sunderland since joining the Black Cats from PSV Eindhoven in 2023 and spent the first half of last season on loan at Bundesliga club Wolfsburg.

Seelt's arrival comes despite the fact that Swansea have been boosted by news that Ben Cabango's heel injury is not serious.

Club captain Cabango limped off during the draw with Sheffield United last weekend but could yet feature when Vitor Matos' team go to Derby County on Saturday.

Seert will join Cabango, Stephen Welsh and Filip Lissah as central defensive options for Matos, though Swansea could yet move for another centre-back before next Tuesday's transfer deadline.

They have lost Cameron Burgess, who played every minute of the 2025-26 Championship campaign, to an Achilles injury which is likely to rule him out until next season.

Lissah, meanwhile, is primarily viewed by Matos as one of his right-back options alongside Josh Key.

Latest Swansea City news, analysis and fan views

Listen to the latest Swansea City interviews, news and discussion on BBC Sounds

Seelt played twice in the Premier League in the early stages of last season having featured only once in Sunderland's promotion 2024-25 campaign, thanks in part to a serious knee injury.

He again had knee problems during his spell at Wolfsburg, with his most recent appearance coming in December 2025.

"Jenson is a talented young player, and he will provide us with valuable depth in our defensive options," said Swansea head coach Vitor Matos.

"He brings physicality and aerial dominance, but also a composure on the ball and ability to read the game. We are happy he will spend the rest of the season with us and we look forward to integrating him into the squad."

Seelt has been involved in Sunderland's pre-season games and is in contention for Swansea's game at Derby.

Stephen Eustaquio could also be involved at Pride Park after joining Swansea on a permanent deal from Porto.

articles.title: UEFA asks US court for FIFA documents for criminal case against Infantino
articles.summary: UEFA considers ‌criminal complaint against Infantino over failed World Cup sell-off plans but suspends boycott threat.
articles.body:
UEFA ⁠has asked a federal court in the United States for permission to obtain testimony and documents from FIFA entities in Florida for use in a planned criminal complaint in Switzerland against FIFA President ⁠Gianni Infantino , according to a court ⁠filing.

In an ex parte application filed on Thursday under US law, European football’s governing body said it is considering ‌criminal proceedings against Infantino and potentially other FIFA officials and advisers over a now-abandoned plan to transfer commercial rights linked to men’s and women’s World Cups and the Club World Cup into a new ⁠subsidiary called FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE).

UEFA ⁠alleged Infantino developed the proposal in secret with a small group of advisers and investors, bypassing FIFA’s normal ⁠governance processes and failing to consult the FIFA Council, regional confederations ⁠or member associations.

“UEFA is actively considering legal action arising out of and in connection with the … plan proposed by FIFA,” the legal document filed in a Florida court read, according to the AFP news agency.

“More specifically, UEFA and other interested parties are preparing to bring criminal claims in Switzerland against Infantino and possibly other FIFA officials and advisors for criminal mismanagement under Article 158 of the Swiss Criminal Code.”

The filing asks ⁠a US court to authorise discovery from FIFA (AMERICAS) Inc and FWC2026 US Inc, two Florida-based FIFA entities. UEFA ‌said the organisations may possess documents and witnesses relevant to how the FFE transaction ‌was ‌conceived, structured, valued and approved.

UEFA’s filing alleged that Infantino and a small group of advisers and investors developed the plan for more than a year without consulting the FIFA Council, regional confederations or the 211 member associations before it was unveiled on July 28.

UEFA said FIFA statutes give the council sole authority to decide how FIFA’s commercial rights are promoted.

According to the filing, Infantino ⁠designated Thrive Eternal, an investment vehicle controlled by Joshua Kushner and affiliated with Thrive Capital, to ⁠lead an investor group. Kushner is the brother of US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner.

UEFA alleged that the investors stood to acquire a permanent financial interest in FIFA’s commercial arm.

Former Liberty Media Chief Executive Greg Maffei was retained as a key commercial adviser on the transaction, UEFA alleged.

UEFA said investors would have paid $4.2bn for a stake in FIFA ⁠Forward Enterprise, valuing the business at about $20bn.

UEFA said the valuation significantly undervalued FIFA’s commercial rights and alleged it was not subjected to an open auction or tested by an independent valuer.

UEFA suspends boycott threat ‘on provisional basis’

The 56-year-old Swiss chief of world football’s governing body did gain some respite later on Thursday when UEFA also announced that it was withdrawing “on a provisional basis” its threat to boycott FIFA tournaments.

That will be music to the ears of Poland, which is hosting next month’s U-20 Women’s World Cup.

The nuclear option of a boycott – widely seen as pivotal in forcing Infantino into his humiliating climbdown just days after launching the proposal last month – remains.

UEFA said after a meeting of Europe’s member associations in Monaco that it had “agreed to suspend, on a provisional basis, the withdrawal by European teams from FIFA competitions in the coming season”.

“This position will remain under constant review and may be reconsidered immediately if circumstances so require.”

articles.title: UEFA preparing to bring criminal proceedings against Gianni Infantino over plan to sell shares in World Cup
articles.summary: UEFA is preparing to bring criminal proceedings against FIFA President Gianni Infantino over the attempt to sell shares in the World Cup to private investors; The revelation is contained in legal documents, with UEFA subpoenaing FIFA and the financial institutions involved
articles.body:
The revelation is contained in legal documents, with UEFA subpoenaing FIFA and the financial institutions involved in the United States to obtain documents related to the scheme.

But the planned legal action would be launched in Switzerland, where FIFA has its main headquarters.

It is a significant move by UEFA in its bid to go beyond trying to oust Infantino from power over the attempt to privatise part of the World Cup.

A legal document seen by Sky News said: "UEFA and other interested parties are preparing to bring criminal claims in Switzerland against Infantino and possibly other FIFA officials and advisors for criminal mismanagement under Article 158 of the Swiss Criminal Code and such further or alternative charges as the developed factual record may support, arising out of the secretive structuring, valuation, financing, and marketing of a transaction that inflicted direct and concrete injury on FIFA's reputation, governance authority, and commercial relationships to the detriment of FIFA as well as its 211 members, including UEFA's 55 member associations."

The application was lodged by UEFA in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York against JP Morgan Bank as well as planned lead investor Thrive Capital and its CEO, Joshua Kushner, who is the brother of Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner.

UEFA is targeting FIFA through courts in Miami, where the world body's legal team is based.

articles.title: Hull City transfer news: Mohamed-Ali Cho becomes 12th summer signing
articles.summary: Hull City sign French forward Mohamed-Ali Cho from Ligue 1 side Nice on a five-year contract.
articles.body:
Hull City have signed French forward Mohamed-Ali Cho from Ligue 1 side Nice on a five-year contract.

The 22-year-old becomes the Tigers' 12th signing of the summer as they continue to strengthen following promotion to the Premier League.

The attacker made 93 appearances for Nice, scoring 12 goals and providing 13 assists during a two-and-a-half-year spell.

Cho played for England Under-16s before switching allegiance to France, who he has represented at under-21 level.

He also has experience of playing in European competitions, having featured 13 times in the Europa League for Nice and in the Champions League for Spanish side Real Sociedad.

Born in France but raised in England, Cho made his professional debut for Angers aged 16 and became the club's youngest scorer.

Hull have spent more than £75m since beating Middlesbrough in the Championship play-off final, including a club record fee for Senegal defender Nobel Mendy.

They made a dream return to the Premier League, after nine years away, with a first ever top-flight win against Manchester United in their opener.

articles.title: 'El Chacho' Coudet, fuera de River Plate tras sólo 27 partidos en el cargo
articles.standfirst: Le sustituirá de forma provisional Leo Ponzio
articles.summary: Le sustituirá de forma provisional Leo Ponzio
articles.body: Eduardo 'El Chacho' Coudet, ex del Alavés, ya no es técnico de River Plate. Todo se precipitó tras la eliminación anoche de la Copa Sudamericana (la segunda competición en Sudamérica) a pies de Independiente de Santa Fe de Colombia (por penaltis tras el 1-1 de la ida y la vuelta). River Plate informó en un comunicado que "Leonardo Ponzio asumirá como entrenador interino del plantel profesional y este jueves por la tarde estará al frente de la práctica. Capitán y uno de los grandes referentes del Club en los últimos años, conquistó 17 títulos en dos ciclos y doce años como jugador. El cuerpo técnico estará conformado por Marcelo Escudero y Christian Manfredi como ayudantes de campo y los preparadores físicos Cristian Segura y Nicolás Paolorossi". Coudet, que renunció al Alavés para irse a entrenar al gigante de Buenos AIres allá por el 3 de marzo de este año, ha durado en River apenas 27 partidos, con este balance: 13 victorias, seis empates y ocho derrotas, con 36 goles a favor y 22 en contra. Fue subcampeón del Torneo Apertura 2026 y quedó eliminado en 1/16 de la Copa Argentina y el citado K.O. de hace menos de 24 horas en octavos de la Sudamericana. Sólo le queda ya jugar por la Liga argentina. 'El Chacho' ya venía muy tocado tras un fatal inicio de temporada en la Liga argentina y con algún enfrentamiento con miembros de la plantilla. Tras perder en una larguísima tanda de penaltis con Santa Fe, dejó su cargo tras ser destituido.

articles.title: Más Madrid y PSOE ven "pelotazo y urbanismo a la carta" en los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas
articles.standfirst: Han reclamado al Gobierno de José Luis Martínez-Almeida que explique cuál es el interés general de la actuación
articles.summary: Han reclamado al Gobierno de José Luis Martínez-Almeida que explique cuál es el interés general de la actuación
articles.body: Más Madrid y PSOE ven un "pelotazo" y un nuevo caso de "urbanismo a la carta" en la operación urbanística sobre los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas, y han reclamado al Gobierno de José Luis Martínez-Almeida que explique cuál es el interés general de la actuación. Las críticas se producen después de una información publicada por 'El País', en la que señala que la modificación urbanística de los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas, aprobada inicialmente por la Junta de Gobierno a finales de julio, contempla nuevos usos que permitirían implantar oficinas, hoteles y comercios, así como equipamientos sanitarios y educativos privados, entre ellos un hospital y una universidad. La concejala de Más Madrid Sara Ladra ha acusado al alcalde de favorecer al club blanco. "En este caso el gran beneficiado es el Real Madrid", ha afirmado en declaraciones remitidas a la prensa, en las que ha calificado la actuación de "otro pelotazo, otra recalificación urbanística al más puro estilo PP". La edil ha cuestionado los usos que, según sostiene, posibilitaría el cambio urbanístico: "Unos terrenos que iban a ser para equipamientos deportivos, ahora serán más hoteles y co-living de lujo, hospitales y universidades privadas, todo para que se forren los de siempre". Frente a ello, ha reclamado para Valdebebas "colegios, centros de salud públicos" y mejores accesos al resto de Madrid, y ha rechazado que necesite "más hoteles y oficinas". Por su parte, el concejal socialista Antonio Giraldo ha calificado la actuación como otro ejemplo de "urbanismo a la carta" el Gobierno de Almeida. En declaraciones remitidas a los medios, el socialista ha puesto en duda el beneficio para la ciudad del cambio hacia hospedaje, hoteles y otros servicios terciarios y se ha reclamado aclarar "cuál es el interés de la ciudad en todo esto". "Lo que está pasando es que a este propietario, en este caso nuevamente el Real Madrid, le ha surgido una nueva oportunidad de negocio con una nueva recalificación", ha sostenido, para concluir que "los intereses que se están primando son los del club y no los de la ciudad".

articles.title: Nsue, en su adiós: “El mejor momento de mi carrera es el gol al Barça en el Camp Nou"
articles.standfirst: Emilio, el ya exfutbolista mallorquín, que además se declara "merengue", repasa su carrera y aborda la actualidad del Mallorca tras anunciar su retiro
articles.summary: El ya exfutbolista mallorquín repasa su carrera y aborda la actualidad del club bermellón tras anunciar su retiro hace cuatro días
articles.body: Emilio Nsue anunció su retiro profesional del fútbol hace tan solo cuatro días poniendo fin a una dilatada carrera de 20 años. El mallorquín ha militado en varios equipos de España como Mallorca, Castellón o Real Sociedad, entre otros, además de jugar en otros países como Inglaterra (Middlesbrough o Birmingham), Chipre o Bosnia. Leyenda con la selección de Guinea Ecuatorial, repasa su trayectoria en una entrevista concedida a Radio Marca Baleares recordando sus mejores momentos como profesional, abordando la actualidad en clave mallorquinista y explicando los motivos de su retiro. ¿Cómo valoras tu carrera? La valoro de una manera positiva, podría haber estado mejor, pero es hasta donde me ha dado y estoy orgulloso de todo lo que he conseguido y de lo que me ha dado el futbol. ¿Cómo vivió la sanción de la FIFA a Guinea por usted? (la Comisión de Disciplina acusaba al mallorquín de no tramitar el cambio de asociación en 2013) Fueron momentos muy duros, estuve un año sancionado, al final gané el caso y, gracias a Dios, pude volver. Fue un año triste porque dejé de jugar con la selección, que es lo que más quería. Al final todo se arregló y me gusta quedarme con las cosas positivas. ¿Qué significa el Mallorca en tu trayectoria? Para mí el Mallorca lo ha sido todo, es el club que me ha visto crecer y el que me ha dado la oportunidad. Me ha dado muchas experiencias y aprendizajes en todos los sentidos. Tengo allí a mi familia y el Mallorca es el club de mi corazón, junto al Atlético Baleares, y les estoy agradecido por todo. ¿Por qué decides retirarte ahora? Ha sido una decisión difícil, porque todavía me encuentro bien físicamente, no he tenido ninguna lesión muscular en los últimos 2 años. Viene dada sobre todo porque los últimos años no he podido pasar tiempo con mi hijo, porque él vive en Mallorca. Todo son momentos, y ya tengo una edad. He tenido opciones para seguir allí (en Mallorca) en el Poblense, el Atlético Baleares también me ha contactado, lo he pensado mucho, pero me han tirado los temas personales y quería pasar tiempo con mi hijo. Sentía que era el momento idóneo y siempre me dejo llevar por lo que siento. ¿Volverás a Mallorca a vivir entonces? Sí, voy a intentar estar entre Alicante y Mallorca y a intentar adaptarme a mi nueva vida porque este año me va a costar bastante, estoy acostumbrado a competir y me tengo que acostumbrar a lo nuevo. Vivir en República Dominicana como dijiste en una entrevista, de momento no, ¿no? Hace muchos años de eso. Tengo a mi mejor amigo y a mi familia, pero mi objetivo es estar cerca de mi hijo, eran cosas de chavales. ¿Cómo ves la temporada para el Mallorca? El Mallorca es el más experimentado en subir y bajar. El año pasado fue un palo duro, no se esperaba, pero ha hecho muy buena plantilla. La Liga es muy difícil porque todos los equipos tienen un mismo objetivo. Estoy seguro de que al final va a estar en la lucha. Hay que intentar tener estabilidad, se ha ganado un partido y se ha perdido otro, esto solo acaba de empezar, las cosas cambian mucho, los jugadores necesitan su tiempo para adaptarse. Lo veremos a mitad de la Liga, pero me gusta mucho el equipo. La Segunda es muy loca y muy dura. Diferencias entre la Segunda de ahora y la que usted vivió Ahora valoro mucho al Mallorca, porque ellos suben y bajan de categoría. Nosotros cometimos el error de descender teniendo un buen equipo y se quedó un grupo de jugadores grande: Hemed, Gerard Moreno, Thomas Partey, Ximo Navarro, Nunes, subió Marco Asensio… teníamos básicamente el equipo de Primera División. Ese fue nuestro error, porque te crees que sigues siendo de Primera y la Segunda nos dio un baño de realidad. Lo más difícil es adaptarse y ser conscientes de que ahora eres de Segunda y, con humildad, hay que intentar conseguir el objetivo. ¿Le preocupa la falta de gol de Adrián Fuentes? Los aficionados piden lo que ellos han visto. Hay que adaptarse a los nuevos contextos, yo pediría paciencia para él. Ya ha demostrado que tiene gol. Cuanta mas presión se le meta a alguien que no se ha adaptado, es peor. Sólo llevamos dos partidos de Liga, paciencia, tiempo, confianza en él y el fútbol cambia de la noche a la mañana ¿Quién ha sido el futbolista que más te ha impresionado compartiendo vestuario? Los dos mejores futbolistas con los que he jugado, aunque los dos eran jóvenes, son: Antoine Griezmann, que coincidí con él en la Real Sociedad, y Marco Asensio. ¿El mayor logro de tu carrera? Creo que conseguir la Bota de Oro en la Copa África porque solo ha habido ocho en la historia y las han conseguido delanteros muy Top como Eto´o, o Drogba. Además yo jugaba para un país de algo más de 1 millón y medio de habitantes y competía contra delanteros como Oshimen o Salah y ganarles fue como un sueño. ¿Y el mejor momento de su carrera? Meterle un gol al Barça en el Camp Nou fue el mejor momento de mi carrera... porque además yo soy merengue.

articles.title: Brahim Díaz y Dean Huijsen se miden a sus orígenes
articles.standfirst: Los dos se criaron en la cantera del Málaga
articles.summary: Los dos se criaron en la cantera del Málaga
articles.body: El choque del domingo en el Bernabéu será especial para un Málaga que vuelve a un escenario mundial muchos años después. Sin embargo, los jugadores de Juanfran Funes no serán los únicos que tengan ganas de este enfrentamiento. En el bloque de José Mourinho dos jugadores esperan con ilusión tener por delante la casaca blanquiazul del conjunto malacitano. Dos boquerones que volverán a medirse a sus raíces muchos años después de su salida. Brahim Díaz y Dean Huijsen jugarán contra el club que les vio crecer y que les convirtió en lo que ahora son. Brahim dejó el Málaga con catorce años en 2013. El Manchester City de Pep Guardiola en una operación liderada por el hermano del técnico catalán. Los ingleses pagaron 300.000 euros para llevarse a la perla de la cantera malacitana. Un Brahim Díaz que siempre ha recordado sus raíces y que cada verano regresa a casa para realizar su campus de entrenamiento en el campo del club que le vio debutar con una pelota, el CD Tiro Pichón. El atacante internacional por Marruecos no se ha cortado nunca a la hora de hablar del Málaga. En 2022 recibió el escudo de plata de Radio MARCA Málaga y confesó su deseo. “Jugaría en el Málaga en un futuro. Es el club de mi tierra y me haría ilusión. Tenemos caminos separados porque así es la vida. Soy malagueño y malaguista. Ojalá pronto esté en Primera. Enfrentarme a ellos o jugar aquí algún día. ¿A quién no le gusta jugar con el equipo de su ciudad?”, explicó por aquellas fechas. El caso de Huijsen es algo más peculiar si cabe. Nacido en Países Bajos, se crió desde bien pequeño en Marbella y cuando ha sido cuestionado ha tenido muy claro que se siente malagueño. Se le ha visto con la camiseta blanquiazul en varios partidos del cuadro malaguista en las últimas temporadas e incluso se le pudo ver en el vestuario del Málaga festejando un tres a cero al Dépor el curso anterior como si fuese un integrante más de la plantilla de Martiricos. El defensa dejó el Málaga en 2021 después de haber llegado al cuadro de La Rosaleda con tan solo 10 años. El futbolista es asiduo de Málaga en las vacaciones de verano y tiene muy claro que su rival el próximo domingo es el equipo de su corazón pese a que la vida le haya llevado a defender las camisetas de Juve, Roma y ahora Real Madrid.

articles.title: Chelsea 2-0 Luton: Danny Welbeck and Hakeem Odoffin's own goal earns Xabi Alonso a first competitive home win to reach Carabao Cup third round
articles.summary: Report and highlights as Chelsea beat Luton Town 2-0 in the Carabao Cup second round; Xabi Alonso named a strong Blues squad including Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Reece James; after a goalless first half, Danny Welbeck and Hakeen Odoffin's own goal saw them past Jack Wilshere's side
articles.body:
With transfer news about Enzo Fernandez and Emiliano Martinez swirling through the air at Stamford Bridge before kick-off, Welbeck's 50th-minute header to open his Chelsea account showed that not all signings have to be high profile.

Alonso actually named a strong Chelsea squad for this one, with Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Reece James all starting in a bid to take the game seriously. They dominated the first half but Palmer and Estevao missed good chances, before Rogers hit the bar with the last kick of the half.

But Welbeck broke Luton's resistance with a bullet header from Malo Gusto to open his Chelsea account in his 19th season playing in England's top league.

His achievements are so impressive that it is worth remembering that he and Luton head coach Jack Wilshere were once Arsenal team-mates.

But it was someone 16 years Welbeck's junior who sealed the result as Estevao's silky run and finish ended the contest with 10 minutes to go - though it would go down as a Hakeem Odoffin own goal.

The result sees Chelsea book a Carabao Cup third-round tie against Leeds United in early September, while Wilshere's Luton lost for the first time in 16 matches in all competitions - which was the longest run out of England's top four leagues.

11: DOUBLE CHANCE! Chelsea start strongly and Palmer has two quickfire efforts saved by Luton goalkeeper Josh Keeley.

19: GOOD SAVE! The Chelsea onslaught continues as James' free-kick is well-saved by Keeley.

39: WIDE! Estevao gets into a good area but drags his effort well wide of goal.

44: SAVE! Luton's best chance of the first half sees Odoffin head a free-kick at goal, but Mike Penders saves.

45+1: OFF THE BAR! Chelsea's best chance of the game sees Rogers hit the bar from Estevao's run and cross.

50: GOAL! Luton's resistance is broken as Welbeck heads home from the middle of the box after Gusto's cross.

67: CHANCE! Kasey Palmer has a good shot from distance but it flies just wide of the near post.

79: GOAL! Estevao seals the win after doing a stepover before finding the opposite corner with a slick finish, which then goes down as a Odoffin own goal.

90+2: CHANCES! Substitute Joao Pedro misses a sitter before fellow replacement Jamie Gittens strikes the foot of the post.

articles.title: Arturo Ruiz deja la Real Sociedad por sorpresa
articles.standfirst: El técnico deja el equipo a dos días del debut liguero y en medio de una eliminatoria de Champions para poner rumbo a la Premier y dirigir al Brighton
articles.summary: El técnico deja el equipo a dos días del debut liguero y en medio de una eliminatoria de Champions para poner rumbo a la Premier y dirigir al Brighton
articles.body: Arturo Ruiz dejó este jueves de ser entrenador de la Real Sociedad, apenas unas horas después de dirigir al equipo en la derrota por 5-2 ante el Chelsea en la ida de la tercera ronda de la previa de la Champions League. Aunque la decisión poco tiene que ver con el resultado de Londres. El técnico madrileño, que llegó a San Sebastián hace un año procedente de Granada y firmó una temporada histórica con el conjunto txuriurdin, comunicó sus planes al club a principios de semana. Había recibido una oferta de un equipo extranjero que estaría dispuesto a pagar su cláusula de rescisión y estaría dispuesto a aceptar. Según ha podido saber MARCA, a día de hoy no hay contrato firmado ni cláusula pagada, si bien las negociaciones están bien encaminadas y a falta de pequeños flecos. El club de destino sería el Brighton & Hove Albion, equipo que quedó en séptima posición la temporada pasada en la WSL (Liga inglesa). Las gaviotas ofrecerían al madrileño un contrato de tres temporadas y un aumento considerable de sueldo. Arturo se convertiría, por tanto, en el cuarto técnico español en el campeonato británico tras Eder Maestre (London City Lionesses), Natalia Arroyo (Aston Villa) y Eva Olid (Manchester United). El agujero para la Real Sociedad es enorme. Por la importancia del cargo y las fechas en las que llega. De momento, el club ha decidido que Maider Castillo, hasta ahora directora deportiva, sea quien asuma el cargo interino en el banquillo al ser poseedora de la Licencia UEFA Pro que se exige para dirigir tanto en España como en Europa. La que fuera jugadora del Eibartarrak, Torrejón y Levante estará acompañada por Fernando Torres, hasta la fecha segundo entrenador del equipo, y Aitor Resende, primer entrenador del filial, hasta que se encuentre una 'solución' definitiva.

articles.title: Champions League Draw 2026-27 League Phase Fixtures Set Ahead of Schedule Release
articles.summary: Europe's biggest football clubs found out their Champions League destiny on Thursday as the 2026-27 UCL League Phase draw took place in Monaco.
articles.body:
Europe's biggest football clubs found out their Champions League destiny on Thursday as the 2026-27 UCL League Phase draw took place in Monaco.

This is the third year of UEFA's expanded 36-team competition, pitting all sides into a large league structure, rather than the traditional groups of four.

Pot 1: Paris Saint-Germain, Bayern Munich, Real Madrid, Liverpool, Inter Milan, Manchester City, Arsenal, Barcelona, Atletico Madrid

Pot 2: Borussia Dortmund, Roma, Sporting, Aston Villa, Porto, Manchester United, Club Brugge, Real Betis, PSV Eindhoven

Pot 3: Feyenoord, Lille, Bodo/Glimt, Napoli, RB Leipzig, Villarreal, Fenerbahce, Shakhtar Donetsk, Galatasaray

Pot 4: Slavia Praha, S. Bratislava, Stuttgart, AEK Athens, LASK, Como, Lens, Viking, Sabah

Knockout phase play-offs: 16/17 & 23/24 February 2027

Each team was handed two opponents from each pot, totalling eight matches. Teams from the same national association cannot be drawn against each other in the League Phase.

The top eight teams will automatically qualify for the Round of 16, while those finishing between ninth and 24th will go into a two-legged playoff round. The winners of those will join the automatic qualifiers along the route that includes two-legged rounds until the single-legged final.

UEFA expects to announce the specific schedule for each match no later than Saturday Aug. 29.

articles.title: Los cambios arbitrales de la UEFA: la mano de Pubill será penalti y suaviza la ley Vinicius
articles.standfirst: Roberto Rosetti, jefe arbitral de la UEFA, repasó en Mónaco las novedades arbitrales que este año se aplicarán en las competiciones europeas
articles.summary: Roberto Rosetti, jefe arbitral de la UEFA, repasó en Mónaco las novedades arbitrales que este año se aplicarán en las competiciones europeas
articles.body: Roberto Rosetti, jefe arbitral de la UEFA, se sentó con los medios presentes en Montecarlo con motivo del sorteo de la Champions para explicar o matizar algunas normas arbitrales para las competiciones europeas esta temporada. Para empezar, la polémica mano de Pubill esta temporada en el partido de Champions ante el Barça dentro del área que quedó sin castigo, será siempre penalti. A partir de ahora cuando haya un toque de balón con la mano en el área después de un saque se sancionará penalti, independientemente de si se pretende poner el balón en juego, en alusión a lo ocurrido en la última Liga de Campeones de entre el Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid con Pubill y Musso. Rosetti ha admitido que ha pedido a los árbitros que sean muy rigurosos para que se cumpla la norma de que únicamente el capitán de cada equipo pueda hablar con él. "No nos gusta que rodeen al árbitro y el que se aproxime al árbitro será amonestado", afirmó. En el pasado Mundial hubo la primera expulsión de un jugador, el paraguayo Miguel Almirón, por llevarse la mano a la boca para dirigirse a un jugador. Esta norma nació a raíz de la polémica de Pestrianni con Vinicius en el partido de la Champions. La UEFA ofrece matices para esta medida. En esta temporada en la Champions no se mostrará tarjeta roja cuando un jugador se cubra la boca para decir algo a un contrario. El árbitro podrá mostrar amarilla si lo considera un comportamiento antideportivo, que podría desembocar después en una acción disciplinaria. "Hemos visto a jugadores pidiendo la roja solo porque un rival se tapa la boca y eso no nos gusta", dijo, tras recordar que el VAR intervendrá en caso de que haya un error de identidad en una segunda amarilla. "Estoy seguro de que veremos pocas intervenciones por errores de identificación en nuestras competiciones", concluyó Rosetti.

articles.body: El cruce de declaraciones entre el Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid continúa. "Es una falta de educación y de respeto. Nuestro presidente, la Dirección Deportiva y todo el club siempre han sido un ejemplo de profesionalidad", dijo Yuste visiblemente enfadado. El vicepresidente continuó: "Con esas palabras han pasado una línea roja. No lo entiendo en absoluto. Me indignan porque el Barcelona siempre ha respetado a todos los rivales y a todos los jugadores del mundo. Me sabe muy mal, han pasado una línea roja". Yuste dijo que tuvo la oportunidad de hablar en Mónaco tanto con Gil Marín como con Cerezo: "Nos hemos saludado porque hay que mantener valores como la educación. No entiendo en absoluto sus declaraciones".

articles.title: PSG to face Barcelona, Man City and Villa in Champions League as draw made
articles.summary: Last season’s runners-up Arsenal, will play the likes of Real Madrid, Borussia Dortmund and Lille in the league phase.
articles.body:
Two-time defending champions Paris Saint-Germain were handed meetings with Barcelona, Manchester City and Aston Villa, among their eight matches in the league phase of this season’s Champions League, when the draw took place on Thursday.

PSG, who beat Arsenal on penalties in Budapest in May to retain the trophy, will play Barcelona, Roma, Turkish champions Galatasaray and Slovan Bratislava of Slovakia at home.

Luis Enrique’s team will travel to England twice to face City and Villa. They beat both teams on the way to winning their first Champions League title in 2025, and also defeated the latter in the UEFA Super Cup in Austria earlier this month.

The French champions will also go to Spain to play Villarreal and Italy to take on a Como side coached by Cesc Fabregas.

“I can’t say anything bad about the Champions League, but I won’t be watching the draw. I will be relaxing and going out on my bike, then we’ll take a look at the menu. But I would sign up for the same result as in the last two years,” Luis Enrique told reporters earlier Thursday.

PSG are aiming to become European champions for a third straight year, something only the Real Madrid of 2016 to 2018 have achieved in the last 50 years.

The first matches in this season’s league phase will be played between Tuesday, September 8 and Thursday, September 10, with the final games in late January. UEFA is expected to announce the full fixture schedule on Saturday.

Last season’s runners-up, Arsenal, the Premier League champions, will notably host Real Madrid, Borussia Dortmund and Lille, as well as Sabah, the club from Azerbaijan who came through four two-legged qualifying ties to reach the league phase for the first time.

The Gunners have a tough list of away ties against Bayern Munich, Real Betis, Napoli and Slavia Prague.

Andoni Iraola’s Liverpool will be at home to Atletico Madrid, Porto, Villarreal and Lens, while playing Inter Milan, Club Brugge, Fenerbahce and Austrian league phase debutants LASK away.

Manchester United, who were not in the first pot of seeds, have home games against Bayern, Roma, RB Leipzig and Sabah, and also a series of difficult away fixtures against Atletico, Sporting of Portugal, Villarreal and Como.

Other notable games include Manchester City visiting Barcelona and Real Madrid entertaining Inter, while last season’s Europa League winners, Villa, must go to Barcelona and play Dortmund at home. Unai Emery’s team will also tackle Istanbul giants Galatasaray and Fenerbahce.

The latter are appearing in the Champions League proper for the first time since 2008/09 after beating Lyon in the playoffs this week.

New names in this season’s competition are Como, who have upset the traditional order in Serie A, and Sabah, while LASK made it to this stage for the first time after a stunning comeback win over Celtic in the playoffs.

Last year’s Norwegian champions Viking, from the city of Stavanger, have reached the Champions League proper for the first time, too, and they have a glamorous fixture schedule that includes Bayern, Atletico, Villa and Napoli.

This is the third season since the introduction of the new format for the Champions League, with 36 teams now all pooled together in one giant league and each playing games against eight different opponents.

This season’s final will be played at the Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid on June 5, 2027.

articles.title: Jablonec 1-0 Rangers (1-1 agg, 4-3 pens): Derek McInnes' woeful Gers fail to qualify for Conference League
articles.summary: Report as Rangers fail to qualify for Conference League; Vakhtang Tchanturishvili's equaliser for Jablonec took the tie to penalties; Findlay Curtis and James Penrice missed their spot kicks; it is the first time Rangers have failed to secure European football since 2017
articles.body:
Leading 1-0 from the first leg at Ibrox last week, Derek McInnes' side turned in a woeful performance in the Czech Republic which lacked creativity and invention, and it proved costly.

Asked how he felt about their humiliation, manager Derek McInnes said: "I'm embarrassed and I'm so disappointed that we've been emptied out of Europe without really turning up and that isn't good enough."

A half-time reboot, involving a move to a different shape and the introduction of skipper Lawrence Shankland, Connor Barron and Findlay Curtis, did little to improve their play and Jablonec midfielder Vakhtang Chanturishvili deservedly levelled the tie in the 73rd minute with a drive which took the game to 1-1 on aggregate, and into extra-time.

There were no more goals which brought penalties, and although Gers keeper Ivor Pandur saved from Filip Zorvan, Curtis fired his spot-kick over the bar and James Penrice was thwarted by Jablonec 'keeper Jan Hanus, leaving Jan Chramosta to fire in the decisive kick.

The defeat is a huge blow to the Glasgow side, who were knocked out of the Europa League qualifiers by Polish side Jagiellonia Bialystok and whose massive rebuild under McInnes is struggling to get off the ground.

It means a team who have impressed in recent times in the Europa League will be without European group stage football for the first time in almost a decade.

The key moments from the Stadion Strelnice

8: CHANCE! Jawo sends a cross into the box, Rangers fail to react but Suchan sends it wide.

13: WIDE! Jawo picks up the ball inside the box but somehow puts it past the post.

20: SAVE! Chukwuani rises to meet Penrice's cross. His header is saved by Hanus.

28: SAVE! Rangers goalkeeper Ivan Pandur punches a cross clear. Jawo wins the ball and his header is then saved.

37: CHANCE! Rangers stand off Jablonec again, allowing Polidar to get a shot away from just inside the box.

49: SAVE! A well-worked corner from Jablonec finds Suchan at the back post. Pandur saves.

51: BLOCK! Shankland is in the right position to meet Naderi's cross, but his effort is blocked.

74: GOAL JABLONEC! Chanturishvili picks up a loose ball, turns and smashes the ball past Pandur.

85: CHANCE! Rangers switch off again as Jablonec take a quick free-kick. It falls to Nebyla, who fires well off target.

90+2: CORNER! Good defending by Makhanya as he sends Chanturishvili's effort past for a corner.

97: CHANCE! Rusek takes aim from distance. It flies wide, but Jablonec are at least having a go!

107: JUST WIDE! Chramosta drags an effort just wide of the post for the hosts.

117: BIG SAVE! Fernandez is slow to react, but Pandur gets down to deny Novak.

119: OVER! Shankland gets his head to Aasgaard's ball into the box, but it's deflected over the bar.

Rangers manager Derek McInnes speaking to Rangers TV:

"So embarrassed with it because we should be winning this tie and there's no two ways about it.

"We could have nicked it in penalties and got through it, which we would have took gladly, but we were way off it and I have to be totally honest with that.

"I'm here to help my players, I want my players to be so much better than what they were tonight.

"I thought we looked young at times, I thought we lacked aggression.

"The responsibility is mine but it's a responsibility shared tonight.

"And for that, I'm embarrassed and I'm so disappointed that we've been emptied out of Europe without really turning up and that isn't good enough."

"Embarrassing. Really, really, really poor from Rangers.

"I don't know where this leaves Derek McInnes.

"Rangers have chopped and changed managers for a number of years now, but looking at this performance there is no connection with the players.

"There is no trust, quite clearly. You can see that with the amount of changes that have been made from game to game.

"If you go back to the last round, were really poor then, but you would put it down to some new players coming in and trying to work with them.

"They look as if there's absolutely no style to anything Rangers are doing. The chopping and changing, one minute playing a back four, the next minute they're playing a back three.

"There is zero trust from the manager towards the players. Now the players just look as if they're all over the place. No confidence.

"I do not know where this leaves Derek McInnes now. It might be that a change is needed once again."

After lacklustre displays like this why should we have high hopes? I think performances like this are ones to worry about, big questions are needed for the manager after this.

Why did McInnes play that team? It was one of the poorest games I've ever seen. McInnes has to go!

Absolute disgrace. Worst European result in the club's history. All comes down to the signings and the people making these decisions not being fit for purpose. We are signing bang average overpriced players. Pathetic.

Get Gerrard back. Derek has no clue how to manage a big club, out of his depth and no plan B. No plan A either.

Making Russell Martin look good at this rate.

Is this the most embarrassing night in Rangers history?

Can I please ask a Rangers fan if they have seen a worse Rangers team? I don't think so!

articles.title: Nigeria’s football federation chief resigns amid corruption allegations
articles.summary: President Bola Tinubu’s office says he has ordered ‘comprehensive reform’ of the country’s football administration.
articles.body:
The president of the Nigeria Football Federation has stepped down amid corruption allegations and a string of disappointing results by the country’s national teams.

Ibrahim Musa Gusau’s announcement on Thursday came a month before the federation is due to hold its next general election.

Several members of the federation’s board also stepped down from their positions, local media reported.

“I decided to resign from my position as the president of NFF,” Gusau told journalists in Abuja, adding that he had “advised” other members of the board to “also resign”.

Local media reported that the Nigeria Football Federation is under investigation by Nigeria’s secret police, the Department of State Services, over the alleged misuse of 17 billion naira (about $12.7m) it received from the government in 2024 to clear a backlog of payments owed to national team players and officials.

After Gusau’s resignation, Nigerian President Bola Tinubu’s office said that he had ordered a “comprehensive reform” of the country’s football administration to correct the “structural deficits within the system”.

“The reform must respond to a longstanding need to strengthen governance, administration, stakeholder representation, development pathways, domestic competitions, and accountability across Nigerian football,” Tinubu said in a statement issued by his media adviser, Bayo Onanuga.

One of Africa’s leading football nations, Nigeria’s governing body has long faced allegations of corruption and mismanagement.

National team players and coaches have repeatedly protested publicly over unpaid allowances.

The latest controversy followed the Super Falcons’ failure to qualify for the 2027 Women’s World Cup.

The 10-time Women’s Africa Cup of Nations winners crashed out in the quarterfinals of this year’s tournament before losing 2-1 to South Africa in a World Cup playoff.

The defeat means that Nigeria will miss the global tournament for the first time since it began in 1991.

The men’s national team, the Super Eagles, also failed to qualify for the last two World Cup tournaments.

Despite resigning, Gusau defended his record and blamed the country’s economic hardship and foreign exchange volatility for the organisation’s financial difficulties.

He also announced a partnership with Adidas that will provide Nigeria with $4.5 million in annual cash payments.

articles.summary: The ACC announced a rule change prohibiting professional athletes in sports including football, men's basketball and women's basketball from returning to play in college on Thursday.
articles.body:
The ACC announced a rule change prohibiting professional athletes in sports including football, men's basketball and women's basketball from returning to play in college on Thursday.

The ban includes players that previously declared for the NFL, NBA or WNBA drafts and did not withdraw consistent with NCAA requirements as well as players that signed a contract with the NBA, WNBA, NFL or any other professional football league.

Players that have been listed on rosters in any of those leagues are also unable to return and compete at ACC schools.

The SEC previously announced a similar rule on Tuesday before the Big 12 followed suit on Wednesday.

The Big Ten also passed a rule that focused on football players getting banned from returning to the conference after signing with an NFL team or appearing on an NFL roster on Tuesday.

articles.title: Rodri debuta con el Barça
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista disputa sus primeros minutos con la camiseta azulgrana contra el Athletic
articles.summary: El centrocampista disputa sus primeros minutos con la camiseta azulgrana contra el Athletic
articles.body: Ya lo había anunciado Hansi Flick ayer miércoles en la rueda de prensa. Dicho y hecho. Rodri jugó este jueves sus primeros minutos con la camiseta azulgrana. El centrocampista madrileño, de 30 años, debutó con el Barça en el compromiso contra el Athletic disputado en el Spotify Camp Nou. El exprofesional del City, que firmó con el equipo culé hasta junio de 2030, se estrenó en el equipo azulgrana esta noche contra el Athletic. Flick le dio entrada en el minuto 62. Saltó al terreno de juego por Marc Bernal. El Spotify Camp Nou le recibió con una sonada ovación. Es, sin duda, el gran fichaje del curso 26-27. El que causa más ilusión y el que genera más expectación. El centrocampista empezó a recibir aplausos mientras calentaba en el descanso. Pero acabó de confirmar el gran cariño que le tiene su nueva afición cuando entró al terreno de juego. El Spotify Camp Nou está rendido hacia el internacional. Rodri será protagonista en el equipo de Flick. El técnico alemán ya lo adelantó ayer miércoles: se frota las manos ante su nuevo doble pivote. "Tiene experiencia, es un líder claro. Junto a Pedri nos permitirá controlar el balón y al rival, que es algo muy importante. Contra el Elche, se perdieron balones. Rodri es uno de los mejores. Disfrutaremos mucho de tenerlos juntos", comentó el entrenador azulgrana, quien también recordó que Bernal es otra opción importante para él en la medular. Esta noche, Rodri entró por el canterano y formó con el canario en la medular. El Barcelona no tenía previsto incorporar al exjugador del Villarreal, reforzar la medular no era una prioridad, pero su predisposición a firmar por el Barça provocó la concreción de la operación.
